content:
Last week, Bloomberg reported that Apple is developing a screen-less fitness device similar to WHOOP or Fitbit Air. As someone who has been using WHOOP for the past 6 months, I do think the concept is great, but there are a few things I'd like Apple to do better.

As for what Apple's screen-less fitness device will look like, we don't have many details yet because the product is still in early development. It's unlikely to debut until 2028 at the earliest. Bloomberg described it as "a slim fabric wristband with a built-in sensor module."

Earlier this year, WHOOP had a promotion with Chase where Sapphire cardholders could get a WHOOP at a discount or for free, so I took the opportunity to sign up. Since then, I've been using WHOOP, although I've never fully committed to using it.

The reason is simple: automatic workout detection is never perfect, and I find it annoying to have to pull out my phone to log a workout, whether it's before or after the activity. With an Apple Watch, you can start a workout right on the watch face, and WHOOP syncs the time back from Apple Health. That's the main reason I've been wearing an Apple Watch.

When you're at the gym, pulling out your phone might be acceptable, but when I'm out cycling or hiking, I don't want to bother with my phone.

So, for Apple's screen-less fitness device, I'd love to see a button and indicator light that can be used to start and stop workouts. You'd still need to go to your phone to categorize the workout, but I'd rather deal with it later than in the moment. Apple could also develop a categorization model based on certain factors.

Conclusion

If Apple can really develop a screen-less fitness device that's useful without having to pull out your phone, I think it would be quite appealing. This form factor has many advantages, including comfortable wear, longer battery life, and the ability to be worn alongside a traditional watch.

TB's Hot Comments

I bought the FitBit Air because after wearing the Apple Watch for so many years, I started to get a bit tired of it. I love mechanical watches, but I also want to keep tracking my health data, and enjoy the convenience that a watch brings, like being able to use Apple Pay without taking out my phone, or using it to open doors when my hands are full. If Apple releases such a product that integrates seamlessly into their ecosystem and supports a simplified version of Apple Pay, door keys, car keys, and other NFC features, plus connects to AirPods to read notifications or perform actions for me through Siri, I'll be the first to buy it.

Personally, after trying WHOOP, I definitely found that I prefer smartwatches, even with shorter battery life. I understand that some people want a screen-less device to minimize distractions, but for me, I just turn on 'Do Not Disturb' mode on my watch.

What do you think about Apple developing a screen-less fitness device? How much would you be willing to pay? Feel free to leave a comment and share your thoughts.
